records.original_sql: SELECT LIST(c.n ORDER BY c.n) FROM ex.data.cacheable_numbers c JOIN (VALUES (3), (7), (9)) t(k) ON c.n = t.k;
records.replacement_sql: SELECT array_agg(c.n ORDER BY c.n) FROM ex.data.cacheable_numbers c JOIN (VALUES (3), (7), (9)) t(k) ON c.n = t.k;
